source_facts.input_residue_policy: A_lo and B_lo allocate all num_mat planes before the product loop
source_facts.product_policy: C_hi product planes are temporary by modulus batch/CRT group
source_facts.reduction_policy: earlier products are reduced to C_mid residue planes or grouped uint32 CRT planes before final reduction
source_facts.final_tail_policy: last modulus/group can remain as high product tail for fused final CRT
source_facts.memory_saving_policy: if full worksize exceeds max_worksize, GEMM searches m/n/k block sizes while NUM_MODULI stays fixed

correction_to_b428_synthetic_model.old_assumption: one residue pair can represent the implementation peak
correction_to_b428_synthetic_model.reason: current GEMMul8 materializes all A_lo/B_lo planes and retains reduced product state until final CRT
correction_to_b428_synthetic_model.retained_value: one-residue streaming remains an algorithmic design point, not a source-backed description of current GEMMul8

new_hypothesis.statement: finite-memory optimization can choose which computation axis to temporalize; current GEMMul8 memory-saving temporalizes matrix m/n/k axes while holding the modulus axis fixed
